name: pr-review-pack
description: Template only — replace with your real pack. Bundles the skill/hook/agent that always travel together for PR review.
_comment_skills: Default location ./skills/ is auto-discovered — leave this field out unless your skills live somewhere else.
_comment_agents: Default location ./agents/ is auto-discovered — leave this field out unless your agents live somewhere else.
_comment_hooks: Only declare this if hooks.json is NOT at the default ./hooks/hooks.json path.
_comment_mcpServers: Only declare this if config is NOT at the default ./.mcp.json path.
